title: CBSE Class 10 Mathematics (Standard) Board Paper
subject: maths
general_instructions: This question paper has 5 Sections A to E.
Section A has 20 MCQs (including Assertion-Reason questions) carrying 1 mark each.
Section B has 5 Very Short Answer questions carrying 2 marks each.
Section C has 6 Short Answer questions carrying 3 marks each.
Section D has 4 Long Answer questions carrying 5 marks each.
Section E has 3 case-based questions carrying 4 marks each.
